caption: The drawing depicts a single, solid, metallic object positioned at the center of the composition, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil on a beige background. The object has a cylindrical shape with a flared base, resembling a spool or a short, wide drum, and features a smooth, reflective surface with three visible circular holes on the top surface. Above and to the left of the main illustration is a smaller, squared-off inset technical drawing, which shows a top-view and side cross-section of the same object with measured dimensions, enhancing the clarity of the object's flat and raised surfaces. The main drawing is enclosed by a large square, and the artist's signature, "Eugene S. Farewell," appears in the lower right corner within the square. The composition is clean, with all elements in black and gray pencil lines on an unadorned, light tan paper background.
title: Pewter Inkwell
